name: Inventory SKU backfill
description: Tests whether a legacy inventory write can leave the new normalized SKU reference stale during backfill.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INT PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT NOT NULL, sku_id INT); CREATE TABLE sku_catalog (id INT PRIMARY KEY, code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL);
seed_sql: INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'SKU-OLD', NULL); INSERT INTO sku_catalog VALUES (1, 'SKU-OLD'), (2, 'SKU-NEW');

phases.name: Compatibility
phases.description: Exercise a legacy writer during migration.

backfill_sku.description: Populate sku_id from the legacy SKU text.
backfill_sku.sql: UPDATE products p SET sku_id = s.id FROM sku_catalog s WHERE p.sku = s.code;

legacy_sku_write.description: Change only the legacy SKU text.
legacy_sku_write.sql: UPDATE products SET sku = 'SKU-NEW' WHERE id = 7;

new_app_read.sql: SELECT p.id, s.code FROM products p LEFT JOIN sku_catalog s ON s.id = p.sku_id WHERE p.id = 7;

invariants.name: SKU consistency
invariants.description: Legacy and normalized SKU values must agree whenever sku_id is populated.
invariants.sql: SELECT p.id, p.sku AS legacy_sku, s.code AS normalized_sku FROM products p JOIN sku_catalog s ON s.id = p.sku_id WHERE p.sku <> s.code;
